rationale: The agent verified the user via email before proceeding. It located the correct order containing the fleece jacket, confirmed the exact change (to red, half-zip), checked product variants and availability, then modified the pending order only after explicit user confirmation. The tool output shows the item was correctly updated and a refund issued; the agent’s statement matched the tool results. For the address update, the agent first reviewed recent orders, then—upon the user’s request—checked all orders to find the Washington DC address, asked for explicit confirmation, and updated the default address accordingly. All actions were within policy, involved proper read checks before writes, and no unsupported claims were made.
